rolling-without-slipping.def: Rolling in which the contact point does not slide on the surface, so the center moves forward one circumference per turn: Δx_cm = RΔθ and v_cm = Rω. Static friction may act but does no work.

total-kinetic-energy.def: The kinetic energy of a rolling object: K = ½Mv_cm² + ½Iω², the translational kinetic energy of its center of mass plus its rotational kinetic energy about the center.

rolling-with-slipping.def: Rolling in which the contact point slides, so v_cm ≠ Rω. Kinetic friction then acts and dissipates mechanical energy until the motion matches (or the object stops).
